correctness.rationale: Exact complete enumeration of the six-point transversal complex gives 54,870 nonempty faces; 27,398 acyclic matched pairs are independently checked over all 358,760 directed covering relations. The integer Morse critical differential has unit Smith ranks 13 in degree 6 and 6 in degree 7, with degree-8 boundary zero and the chain condition explicitly checked. The 4-connectivity of its Morse CW model, contractibility of the star cluster, and the simplicial concentration retraction give X7 ≃ S9 ∨ ΣL6. All integer homology groups then follow without finite-to-infinite extrapolation. Both verification scripts run successfully.

value.rationale: The example is the first nontrivial parameter in the explicitly open all-k torsion question of Feng (2026). Field ranks known previously leave every possible odd torsion obstruction unresolved, while the signed integer Morse differential excludes them exactly and gives the integral groups. The result is a natural meaningful finite cutoff with explicit reproducibility, also giving 5-connectivity and a structural suspension decomposition; no unsupported general or wedge claim is made.
